Can I pay in installments or split payment?
Yes, you have options for both:
Financing in Installments:
You can finance your purchase through Affirm at checkout.
Available payment options, terms, and interest rates (APR) depend on an eligibility check and your location (Canada or the US).
In Canada, options can include interest-free bi-weekly payments or monthly payment terms, and Affirm accepts debit cards, Pre-Authorized Debit (PAD), and select credit cards. More details can be found at the Affirm Help Center.
In the US, options depend on purchase amount and eligibility. Additional lender details are available at affirm.com/lenders.
Splitting Payment Across Cards:
Since our sofas are modular, one way to split payment between two cards is to place multiple orders containing the different parts of the sofa. Keep in mind that because they would be separate orders, they might not be delivered at the same time.
